Curvature then does real computational work (log/exp at the current prefix point, Möbius subtraction) and behaviour real work (the target direction), and the two meet in ONE equation: r_{k+1} = log^kappa_{Q_k}( exp^kappa_{Q_k}( (1-beta) log^kappa_{Q_k}(x_i) + beta log^kappa_{Q_k}(s_i) ) ). IDEA: succ-pull-curved-residual-rq
TITLE: Behaviour-pulled geodesic residual: training transitions choose the target that every deeper RQ level is asked to encode, inside the Poincare log/exp of the current prefix point
MOTIVATION: In a plain RQ-VAE every residual level is asked only to reconstruct what the previous levels missed about the item itself, so the deep prefix digits store item-specific reconstruction detail rather than transition-relevant structure. A generative next-item model that emits those deep digits therefore spends its later tokens on information that does not help predict the successor. This proposal makes each deeper level encode a geodesically interpolated target between the item and the hyperbolic centroid of its training successors, so prefix capacity is spent where the transition structure lives.
NOVELTY: The earlier mechanisms act on the codebook update (successor-weighted Frechet means), on the curvature itself (prefix-transition-controlled curvature), or on the assignment/radius (behaviour-ranked radial assignment). This one leaves codebooks, assignment rule and curvature untouched and moves the behaviour signal into the residual map: the vector handed from level k to level k+1 is a tangent vector at the current decoded prefix point q-tilde_k pointing at a behaviour-blended target, computed with Poincare log/exp and Mobius subtraction. Removing the behaviour term, or taking the curvature to zero, provably degenerates to the plain Euclidean residual, so the three arms are strictly nested rather than a loss bolted onto an unchanged quantizer.
CHANGE: At each level, form a target point t_i,k = exp^kappa_{q-tilde_k}((1-beta) log^kappa_{q-tilde_k}(x_i) + beta log^kappa_{q-tilde_k}(s_i)) where x_i is the item's ball point and s_i the ball point of its popularity-adjusted training-successor centroid, and pass r_{k+1} = log^kappa_{q-tilde_k}(t_i,k) to the next level's encoder/quantizer instead of x_i - q_k.
SPECIFICATION: Precompute once, before training: R = RMS norm of the epoch-0 encoder outputs over all 24556 training items; kappa = 1/R^2 (ball radius radius = sqrt(1/kappa)); directed training-transition counts n_ij; in-degree d_j; m = median positive out-degree clipped to [1,20]; w_ij proportional to n_ij/sqrt(d_j) over the top-m successors; b_i = sum_j w_ij zhat_j with zhat_j the frozen epoch-0 encoder output of item j; beta = 1/(1+m); store the 24556 x d table B = [b_i] (zeros for items with no successor). During training, per encoder forward: x_i = exp^kappa_0(z_i), s_i = exp^kappa_0(b_i), q-tilde_0 = 0, r_1 = x_i; for k = 1..K: c_k = argmin_{c in C_k} ||r_k - c||^2 with straight-through gradient into r_k; q-tilde_k = exp^kappa_0(sum_{l<=k} c_l); t_i,k = exp^kappa_{q-tilde_k}((1-beta) log^kappa_{q-tilde_k}(x_i) + beta log^kappa_{q-tilde_k}(s_i)); r_{k+1} = log^kappa_{q-tilde_k}(t_i,k). Levels k >= K reuse t_i,K-1 as the final accumulated code point for the decoder. Loss is unchanged (reconstruction of z_i + commitment + codebook); no new loss weight is introduced, only the derived kappa and beta.
COST: One pre-training pass over the training transitions plus one frozen forward pass over 24556 items (seconds to a few minutes). Per training step the extra work is K = 3 Poincare exp/log/Mobius evaluations per item in the batch: O(d) reductions each, no matmuls, no extra parameters, no extra memory beyond the 24556 x d float table (about 24556 x 64 x 4 bytes = 6.3 MB at d = 64). Per-step at the frozen scale (245

56 training items, 24 steps per epoch, 3000 epochs = 72000 steps) this is roughly 1.00-1.02x baseline wall clock; the 3000-epoch Stage 2 budget is unchanged.
HYPOTHESIS: If deep prefix digits are the bottleneck for generative next-item prediction, then budgeting them toward the transition-relevant region should make the level-2/level-3 prefix of an item's true successor more predictable and should move Stage 3 test Recall@10 above 0.065 in the single frozen run, without a collapse in codebook usage. Observable: deep-prefix transition predictability (probability mass the SID prefix model assigns to a held-out-style training transition partner's level-k prefix) rises relative to the epoch-0 SID assignment, `Deep-prefix entropy falls, per-level codebook usage stays above the baseline's minimum, and Stage 3 test_recall@10 exceeds 0.065.
RISKS: The pull can dominate reconstruction at the deepest level, so codes stop being item-discriminative and two different items collapse onto the same deep prefix, hurting Recall; beta = 1/(1+m) may be too strong for hub items with many successors. The successor centroid computed from frozen epoch-0 latents is stale by the end of training. The curvature scale R makes the ball just fit the latent cloud, so items near the boundary can saturate tanh/arctanh and produce exploding or vanishing tangent vectors. If the baseline's deep digits are not in fact the bottleneck, the coupling will be neutral at best and the single run gives no rescue.
BEHAVIOR SIGNAL: Directed item-to-item transitions of the training split, popularity-adjusted and truncated to each item's top-m successors.
BEHAVIOR COMPUTATION: Only the training split of the interaction sequences is read. Counts n_ij of consecutive (i -> j) co-occurrence over training sequences; d_j = number of distinct training predecessors of j; edge weights w_ij = (n_ij / sqrt(d_j)) / sum over the kept set, keeping the top-m successors where m is the median positive out-degree of the training transition graph clipped to [1,20] (a measured quantity, not a chosen one). The behaviour vector b_i = sum_j w_ij zhat_j is formed once from the frozen epoch-0 encoder outputs zhat_j of all 24556 items and cached in a table; items with no training successor get b_i = 0 and beta = 0.
LEAKAGE BOUNDARY: The successor table uses only training-split transitions and item latents produced by a forward pass that reads no interaction data from validation or test; validation and test sequences are never counted, never used to build b_i, never used to set m, beta, kappa or R, and never used to choose any constant. R and m are measured on the training items/transitions only. Nothing about a validation or test interaction can reach the SID construction; the behavioural diagnostics are computed on training transitions and recorded only.

HYPERBOLIC LOCATION: In the residual map of the RQ-VAE, between consecutive quantization levels - i.e. in the vector that level k+1's encoder and codebook see - and in the decoded prefix points q-tilde_k, not in the codebook update and not in the assignm

ent cost.
COUPLING PATH: The single pathway is the residual chain: r_{k+1} is defined as the Poincare tangent at q-tilde_k to the target that mixes the item point x_i and the behaviour centroid s_i. Behaviour supplies where the target sits (via beta and s_i), curvature supplies the whole geometry in which that mixture and the residual are defined (log, exp, Mobius subtraction). Setting beta = 0 deletes the behaviour term and the residual becomes the purely curved residual log^kappa_{q-tilde_k}(x_i); setting kappa -> 0 turns every map into + or - and the residual becomes (1-beta)(x_i - q_k) + beta(s_i - q_k), which at beta = 0 is exactly the vanilla RQ residual. No other term in the model touches either.
COUPLING EQUATION: r_{k+1} = log^kappa_{q-tilde_k}( t_i,k ) with t_i,k = exp^kappa_{q-tilde_k}( (1 - beta) * log^kappa_{q-tilde_k}( x_i ) + beta * log^kappa_{q-tilde_k}( s_i ) ) and s_i = exp^kappa_0( sum_j w_ij zhat_j ), q-tilde_k = exp^kappa_0( sum_{l<=k} c_l ); equivalently r_{k+1} = (1-beta) * log^kappa_{q-tilde_k}(x_i) + beta * log^kappa_{q-tilde_k}(s_i) after the common exp/log cancellation, i.e. a behaviour weight beta multiplying a curved displacement in a curved geometry.
OBSERVABLES: SID assignment: which codebook entries each item receives at levels 2 and 3, and how many items sharing a level-1 prefix share the deeper prefix. Gradient/parameter update: the residual fed to levels 2 and 3 changes magnitude and direction, so c_2, c_3 and the deeper encoder weights follow a different trajectory than baseline. Prefix behaviour predictability: fraction of training transitions whose successor shares the item's level-2 and level-3 prefix, and the deep-prefix entropy. Stage 3: test_recall@10 of the single frozen run against the 0.065 target. Also recorded: reconstruction MSE, codebook usage per level, fraction of items with beta = 0, fraction of tangents clipped by the ball projection.
ABLATION BEHAVIOR OFF: beta = 0 for all items, so s_i never enters: r_{k+1} = log^kappa_{q-tilde_k}(x_i), a purely curved residual quantizer with no transition information anywhere. The switch exists in the code (a single `if behaviour_on` that sets beta to 0 and skips the s_i table lookup); no arm is trained in this round.
ABLATION GEOMETRY OFF: kappa -> 0 (exp, log and Mobius subtraction replaced by their Euclidean limits +, -), beta kept: r_{k+1} = (1-beta)(x_i - q_k) + beta(s_i - q_k), a Euclidean residual toward a Euclidean successor centroid. The switch exists as a single `if curvature_on` branch that swaps the three map functions; no arm is trained in this round.
ABLATION BOTH ON: beta = 1/(1+m) and kappa = 1/R^2 together, the single run that is actually trained: r_{k+1} = log^kappa_{q-tilde_k}( exp^kappa_{q-tilde_k}((1-beta) log^kappa_{q-tilde_k}(x_i) + beta log^kappa_{q-tilde_k}(s_i)) ). With both switches off the code path returns exactly the baseline Euclidean residual x_i - q_k, so the three arms are nested one inside the other.
SPEC EQUATIONS: (1) R = sqrt(mean_i ||z_i^(epoch0)||^2), kappa = 1/R^2. (2) m = clip(median positive out-degree, 1, 20), beta = 1/(1+m). (3) w_ij = (n_ij / sqrt(d_j)) / sum_{j' in S_i}(n_ij' / sqrt(d_j')), S_i = top-m successors by n_ij. (4) b_i = sum_{j in S_i} w_ij zhat_j (stop-grad, cached), s_i = exp^kappa_0(b_i). (5) x_i = exp^kappa_0(z_i). (6) q-tilde_0 = 0, r_1 = x_i. (7) for k = 1..K: c_k = argmin_c ||r_k - c||^2 (straight-through), q-tilde_k = exp^kappa_0( sum_{l<=k} c_l ), t_i,k = exp^kappa_{q-tilde_k}((1-be

ta) log^kappa_{q-tilde_k}(x_i) + beta log^kappa_{q-tilde_k}(s_i)), r_{k+1} = log^kappa_{q-tilde_k}(t_i,k). (8) reconstruct z-hat_i = sum_{l<=K} c_l via the unchanged decoder; loss = ||z-hat_i - z_i||^2 + commitment + codebook, unchanged weights.
SPEC INPUTS OUTPUTS: Inputs: the encoder latent z_i of each item in the batch, the cached table row b_i, the accumulated code sum s_{<=k}, and the derived constants kappa and beta. NOVELTY: Existing mechanisms here act on the codebook update (successor-weighted Frechet means), on the curvature itself (prefix-transition-controlled curvature), or on assignment and radius (behaviour-ranked radial assignment). This leaves codebooks, assignment rule and curvature schedule untouched and moves behaviour into the residual map: the vector handed from level k to k+1 is a tangent vector at the current decoded prefix point q-tilde_k pointing at a behaviour-blended target, computed with Poincare log/exp and Mobius subtraction. Removing the behaviour term, or taking curvature to zero, degenerates to the plain Euclidean residual, so the three arms are strictly nested rather than a loss bolted onto an unchanged quantizer.
CHANGE: At each level form t_i,k = exp^kappa_{q-tilde_k}((1-beta) log^kappa_{q-tilde_k}(x_i) + beta log^kappa_{q-tilde_k}(s_i)), with x_i the item's ball point and s_i the ball point of its popularity-adjusted training-successor centroid, and pass r_{k+1} = log^kappa_{q-tilde_k}(t_i,k) to the next level's encoder and quantizer instead of x_i - q_k.
SPECIFICATION: Precompute once before training: R = RMS norm of epoch-0 encoder outputs over all 24556 training items; kappa = 1/R^2 (ball radius sqrt(1/kappa)); directed training-transition counts n_ij; in-degree d_j; m = median positive out-degree clipped to [1,20]; w_ij proportional to n_ij/sqrt(d_j) over the top-m successors; b_i = sum_j w_ij zhat_j with zhat_j the frozen epoch-0 encoder output of item j; beta = 1/(1+m); cache the 24556 x d table B = [b_i] (zeros where no successor). Per encoder forward: x_i = exp^kappa_0(z_i), s_i = exp^kappa_0(b_i), q-tilde_0 = 0, r_1 = x_i; for k = 1..K: c_k = argmin_{c in C_k} ||r_k - c||^2 (straight-through into r_k); q-tilde_k = exp^kappa_0(sum_{l<=k} c_l); t_i,k as above; r_{k+1} = log^kappa_{q-tilde_k}(t_i,k). The unchanged decoder reconstructs z-hat_i = sum_{l<=K} c_l. Loss unchanged (reconstruction + commitment + codebook); no new loss weight, only derived kappa and beta.
COST: One pass over training transitions plus one frozen forward pass over 24556 items (seconds to minutes). Per step the extra work is K = 3 Poincare exp/log/Mobius evaluations per batch item: O(d) reductions each, no matmuls, no new parameters, no memory beyond the 24556 x d table (~6.3 MB at d = 64). At the frozen scale (24556 training items, 24 steps per epoch, 3000 epochs = 72000 steps) roughly 1.00-1.02x baseline wall clock; Stage 2 and Stage 3 budgets unchanged.
HYPOTHESIS: If deep prefix digits are the bottleneck for generative next-item prediction, budgeting them toward the tr

ansition-relevant region makes the level-2/level-3 prefix of an item's true successor more predictable and lifts Stage 3 test Recall@10 above 0.065 in the single frozen run without a codebook-usage collapse. Observable: the fraction of training transitions whose successor shares the item's level-2/level-3 prefix rises versus the epoch-0 SID assignment, deep-prefix entropy falls, per-level usage stays above the baseline minimum, Stage 3 test_recall@10 > 0.065.
RISKS: The pull can dominate reconstruction at the deepest level so codes stop being item-discriminative and distinct items collapse onto one deep prefix, hurting Recall; beta = 1/(1+m) may be too strong for hub items. The successor centroid from frozen epoch-0 latents is stale by the end of training. With the ball radius set by R the latent cloud just fits, so boundary items can saturate tanh/arctanh and give exploding or vanishing tangents. If deep digits are not the bottleneck the coupling is neutral and the single run offers no rescue.
BEHAVIOR SIGNAL: Directed item-to-item transitions of the training split, popularity-adjusted and truncated to each item's top-m successors.
BEHAVIOR COMPUTATION: Training split only. n_ij = counts of consecutive (i -> j) co-occurrence over training sequences; d_j = number of distinct training predecessors of j; w_ij = (n_ij / sqrt(d_j)) / sum over the kept set, keeping the top-m successors with m = median positive out-degree of the training transition graph clipped to [1,20] (measured, not chosen). b_i = sum_j w_ij zhat_j formed once from frozen epoch-0 encoder outputs of all 24556 items and cached; items with no training successor get b_i = 0 and beta = 0.
LEAKAGE BOUNDARY: The successor table uses only training-split transitions and item latents from a forward pass that reads no validation or test interaction; validation and test sequences are never counted, never used to build b_i, never used to set m, beta, kappa or R, never used to choose any constant. R and m come from training items and training transitions only. Behavioural diagnostics are computed on training transitions and recorded only, never used as an admission gate.
HYPERBOLIC OPERATOR: Poincare ball of curvature -kappa with kappa = 1/R^2 from the measured RMS latent norm: exp^kappa_p(v) = p (+) tanh(sqrt(kappa)||v||/2) v/(sqrt(kappa)||v||) via Mobius addition; log^kappa_p(y) = (2/sqrt(kappa)) artanh(sqrt(kappa)||(-p)(+)y||) (-p)(+)y/||(-p)(+)y||; Mobius subtraction (-p)(+)y. All three are used in the behaviour blend and in the residual.
HYPERBOLIC LOCATION: In the residual map of the RQ-VAE, between consecutive quantization levels - in the vector that level k+1's encoder and codebook see - and in the decoded prefix points q-tilde_k; not in the codebook update, not in the assignment cost.
COUPLING PATH: The single pathway is the residual chain: r_{k+1} is the Poincare tangent at q-tilde_k to the target that mixes x_i and s_i. Behaviour supplies where the target sits (beta, s_i); curvature supplies the geometry in which the mixture and the residual exist (log, exp, Mobius subtraction). beta = 0 leaves the purely curved residual log^kappa_{q-tilde_k}(x_i); kappa -> 0 turns the maps into + and - giving (1-beta)(x_i - q_k) + beta(s_i - q_k), which at beta = 0 is exactly the vanilla residual. No other term touches either.
COUPLING EQUATION: r_{k+1} = log^kappa_{q-tilde_k}( t_i,k ), t_i,k = exp^kappa_{q-tilde_k}( (1-beta)*log^kappa_{q-tilde_k}(x_i) + beta*log^kappa_{q-tilde_k}(s_i) ), s

_i = exp^kappa_0( sum_j w_ij zhat_j ), q-tilde_k = exp^kappa_0( sum_{l<=k} c_l ); after exp/log cancellation r_{k+1} = (1-beta)*log^kappa_{q-tilde_k}(x_i) + beta*log^kappa_{q-tilde_k}(s_i): a behaviour weight beta multiplying a curved displacement in a curved geometry.
OBSERVABLES: SID assignment: codebook entries per item at levels 2 and 3, and how many items sharing a level-1 prefix also share the deeper prefix. Gradient/parameter update: residuals into levels 2-3 change magnitude and direction, so c_2, c_3 and deeper encoder weights follow a different trajectory. Prefix behaviour predictability: fraction of training transitions whose successor shares the item's level-2/level-3 prefix; deep-prefix entropy. Stage 3: test_recall@10 versus 0.065. Also reconstruction MSE, per-level codebook usage, fraction of items with beta = 0, fraction of clipped tangents.
ABLATION BEHAVIOR OFF: beta = 0 for all items, s_i never enters, r_{k+1} = log^kappa_{q-tilde_k}(x_i): a purely curved residual quantizer with no transition information. Switch exists as `if behaviour_on` setting beta = 0 and skipping the s_i lookup; no arm is trained this round.
ABLATION GEOMETRY OFF: kappa -> 0 (exp, log, Mobius subtraction replaced by Euclidean + and -), beta kept: r_{k+1} = (1-beta)(x_i - q_k) + beta(s_i - q_k), a Euclidean residual toward a Euclidean successor centroid. Switch exists as `if curvature_on` swapping the three map functions; no arm is trained this round.
ABLATION BOTH ON: beta = 1/(1+m) and kappa = 1/R^2 together, the single trained run: r_{k+1} = log^kappa_{q-tilde_k}( exp^kappa_{q-tilde_k}((1-beta) log^kappa_{q-tilde_k}(x_i) + beta log^kappa_{q-tilde_k}(s_i)) ). Both switches off returns exactly the baseline x_i - q_k, so the arms are nested.
